title: Chestnut Roast
description: HOW TO BATCH: Cool the fish within 2 hours of cooking, then divide into individual portions and freeze immediately. Find detailed guidelines on reheating on here.

ingredients.text: 150g mushrooms, finely chopped (a food processor is good for this)
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Spray the loaf tin with low-calorie cooking spray and line it with baking parchment.
Spray a large frying pan with low-calorie cooking spray and place over a medium heat.
Add the onion, carrot and mushrooms and sauté for about 10 minutes. The vegetables will release some liquid – keep sautéing until this has evaporated and you have a drier mix.
Add the garlic granules, thyme and soy sauce and stir over the heat for another minute, then stir in the tomato puree and white wine vinegar.
Blitz the bread in a blender to make breadcrumbs.
Place the cooked vegetables in a mixing bowl and add the breadcrumbs and chestnuts.
Taste the mix and season with salt and pepper to taste.
When you are happy with the seasoning, stir in the egg and press the mix into the prepared loaf tin.
Bake the chestnut roast in the preheated oven for 30–35 minutes, until golden and firm to touch.
Remove from the oven and allow to rest in the tin for 10 minutes before turning out and cutting into six slices.
